instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot, eye-level. Set in an outdoor covered training area with concrete flooring and white pillars under bright daylight. On the right, the man in the beige t-shirt (R1) stands in a defensive boxing stance with his gloves raised. On the left, the man in the blue tank top (R2) holds his boxing gloves up to guard his face. The two men are in close proximity, their gloves touching in a sparring guard. In the background, a man in a blue shirt and face mask sits on a table with arms crossed. Bright natural daylight casts soft shadows across the scene.

R2 is the sparring participant guarding his face with raised boxing gloves
